SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
--LINKMYROWDATA DECLARE @SITE VARCHAR(30)='{0}' DECLARE @DOCNUM VARCHAR(30)='{1}' --领料通知单
SELECT '' SITE ,'' CPNITMNO ,'' CPNITMVER ,'' CPNLOT ,'' CPNSUBLOT ,'' ITMNAM ,N'' SYBS ,0 QTY ,0 UOMCOE ,0 QTYSTU ,0 SUBQTYSTU ,0 SUBQTY ,0 WIPQTYSTU ,0 WIPQTY ,0 NEDQTY --待领包数 ,0 NEDQTYSTU --待领数量 ,'' UOM ,'' STU ,'' DEPT ,'' DEPTNAM ,'' DESTWH --目标仓库 ,'' DESTLOC --目标库位 ,'' DOCNUM ,0 DOCLIN ,'' REMARK ,'' UOMFLG ,'' STUFLG ,'' ROW_BACKCOLOR ,'mui-hidden' UNHIDDENFLG --包装数量 控制扫码选择显示 ,'' HIDDENFLG --库存数量 控制扫码选择显示 UNION ALL SELECT H.SITE ,S.CPNITMNO ,S.CPNITMVER ,S.CPNLOT ,S.CPNSUBLOT ,M.ITMNAM ,N'' SYBS ,Cast(S.QTY AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) QTY ,Cast(S.UOMCOE AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) UOMCOE ,Cast(S.QTYSTU AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) QTYSTU ,Cast(Isnull(SUBQTYSTU, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) SUBQTYSTU ,Cast(Isnull(SUBQTY, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) SUBQTY ,Cast(Isnull(WIPQTYSTU, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) WIPQTYSTU ,Cast(Isnull(WIPQTY, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) WIPQTY ,Cast(S.QTY - Isnull(WIP.WIPQTY, 0) - Isnull(WIP.SUBQTY, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) NEDQTY --待领包数 ,Cast(S.QTYSTU - Isnull(WIP.WIPQTYSTU, 0) - Isnull(WIP.SUBQTYSTU, 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) NEDQTYSTU --待领数量 ,S.UOM UOM ,M.STU ,H.DEPT ,ED.DEPTNAM ,H.DESTWH --目标仓库 ,H.DESTLOC --目标库位 ,S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCLIN ,S.REMARK ,Iif(S.SRCTYP = 'UOM' AND S.QTY > Isnull(WIP.SUBQTY, 0), '', 'mui-hidden') UOMFLG ,Iif(S.SRCTYP = 'STU' AND S.QTY > Isnull(WIP.SUBQTY, 0), '', 'mui-hidden') STUFLG ,CASE WHEN S.QTY = WIP.SUBQTY THEN 'H02' WHEN Isnull(WIP.WIPQTY, 0) <> 0 THEN 'E02' ELSE 'C01' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR ,'' UNHIDDENFLG --包装数量 控制扫码选择显示 ,'mui-hidden' HIDDENFLG --库存数量 控制扫码选择显示 FROM MFGPKL S LEFT JOIN MFGPKH H ON H.DOCNUM = S.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN ENTDEPT ED ON ED.DEPT = H.DEPT LEFT JOIN ITM M ON S.CPNITMNO = M.ITMNO LEFT JOIN (SELECT Sum(( Iif(DOCSTA = 2, 1, 0) * QTYSTU )) SUBQTYSTU --提交数量 ,Sum(( Iif(DOCSTA = 2, 1, 0) * QTY )) SUBQTY --提交数量 ,Sum(( Iif(DOCSTA = 2, 0, 1) * QTYSTU )) WIPQTYSTU --待提交数量 ,Sum(( Iif(DOCSTA = 2, 0, 1) * QTY )) WIPQTY --待提交数量 ,SRCDOC ,SRCLIN FROM STKCHG WHERE SRCDOC = @DOCNUM GROUP BY SRCDOC ,SRCLIN) WIP ON WIP.SRCDOC = S.DOCNUM AND WIP.SRCLIN = S.DOCLIN WHERE S.DOCTYP = 'MPH' AND S.CLOSTA = 0 AND H.SITE = @SITE AND S.DOCNUM = @DOCNUM ORDER BY DOCLIN
